name: user-turn-remember
description: The user asks OcuTalon to remember a partner's contact, as the guide's Ask it to remember control sends it (Story 30.9, DW-890). The case is right only when Triage decides tell now with no fallback, which needs a reply that gives a confidence, and its reasons only classify the turn as the user's own message: they never describe the state of a production, what Triage can or cannot look up, or whether anything needs the user.

turn.text: Remember that the Results partner's contact is Lee.

recordedBy: written for the evaluation set (Story 30.9, DW-890)
